symptom: Assembly configurations by suppression: per-component `SetSuppression2` on ~100 components of a 770-component assembly ran > 25 min (killed)
fix: select all seeds + pattern features, then ONE `EditSuppress2` per configuration; pattern instances follow their pattern feature

symptom: Same job still 15 min per configuration after that fix
cause: measured: `FirstFeature/GetNextFeature` walk of the tree = 55 s on 770 components, and the script walked it once PER pattern looked up (56x); `GetComponents` 26 s; select 0.2 s; `EditSuppress2` 0.6 s; rebuild 2.6 s
fix: walk the tree ONCE into a name -> feature dict: 35 s per configuration. Measure before guessing: the cost was COM traffic, not SolidWorks work

symptom: `IsSuppressed()` said all 770 components were suppressed right after a silent `OpenDoc6`
fix: count resolved with `GetSuppression2() != 0` after a rebuild

symptom: Equation `sqr(TOP_H^2 + LEAN^2)` gave 5778.4 instead of 5821.5 with the global LEAN = -500
cause: a negative global under `^` is evaluated as -(500^2)
fix: never square a signed global with `^`: write `X*X` (or `abs(X)^2`). The volume / bbox check caught it

symptom: SolidWorks died during a 74-part batch (part 33): "RPC server is unavailable", then "Operation unavailable" for every later part
fix: restart and rerun: fingerprints skip the finished parts; write the 'last good values' snapshot only after a PASS so the change is detected again

symptom: Lock on the main assembly after a killed run
cause: the killed Python left it open in the SAME session (89 documents)
fix: `CloseDoc(title)` in the connected session before the `open(path, 'r+b')` lock test

symptom: (library bug, fixed) update mode rewrote equations in place but reported the part 'unchanged', closed it unsaved and stored its fingerprint
cause: only global / property changes counted as a change
fix: `PartBuilder.edited` lists equation / sketch edits; the runner saves + verifies when it is not empty
